notes.title: We have to postpone the release (through no fault of our own)
notes.content:
Hello, we have to postpone the release of the game. [b]Unfortunately, the game is on steam verification.[/b]

At the moment, the [b]game is fully completed[/b] and ready for release, but we are not given the opportunity to release it.
We'll release the game as soon as we're given the opportunity

[h1]We really hope for your understanding and thank you for waiting![/h1]
